title: Dental Sourcer
description:
Position Overview

RSMC Services is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Offshore Sourcer to support the recruitment of dental professionals for clients across the US. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and pre-qualifying top talent, ensuring a continuous pipeline of high-quality candidates. The ideal candidate has experience in high-volume candidate sourcing, Boolean search techniques, and leveraging multiple recruitment platforms. This position requires strong research skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work efficiently in a remote, fast-paced environment while closely collaborating with recruiters and hiring managers.



Job Description

• Utilize various sourcing techniques, including Boolean search, job boards, and social media platforms, to identify potential candidates.

• Conduct market research to map talent pools and stay updated on industry trends.

• Build and maintain a pipeline of pre-qualified candidates for current and future hiring needs.

• Engage passive candidates through effective outreach strategies.

• Screen candidate profiles and assess initial qualifications before passing them to recruiters.

• Collaborate with recruiters and hiring managers to understand job requirements and sourcing priorities.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS).

• Track and report sourcing metrics to optimize recruitment strategies.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Onshore Recruiter Manager

1. Candidate Sourcing & Pipeline Development

o Source qualified dental professionals (Dentists, Hygienists, Assistants, Front Office Staff) to the pipeline per month.

o Ensure that sourced candidates meet job requirements (licenses, experience, location, availability).

o Maintain an active database of pre-screened candidates to support ongoing hiring needs.

2. Speed & Efficiency

o Identify and submit qualified candidates per week to offshore recruiters for screening.

o Reduce time-to-source candidates using Boolean searches, LinkedIn, job boards, and referral networks.

o Ensure a response time of under 24 hours when engaging with potential candidates.

3. Data Accuracy & ATS Management

o Maintain 100% accuracy in candidate data entry in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

o Update candidate profiles with correct contact information, credentials, and availability before submission.

o Ensure zero duplicate or unqualified candidate submissions, improving recruiter efficiency.

4. Communication & Collaboration

o Ensure daily coordination with offshore recruiters to prioritize sourcing needs.

o Maintain candidate outreach response, improving engagement and conversion.

5. Market Intelligence & Process Improvement

o Identify new sourcing channels or strategies per quarter to enhance talent acquisition.

o Track and report weekly sourcing performance metrics to optimize search strategies.

o Stay updated on state dental industry hiring trends to refine sourcing strategies.



Qualifications

• Experience: 1-2+ years of experience in talent sourcing or recruitment, preferably in healthcare, dental, or high-volume staffing.

• Candidate Sourcing Expertise: Ability to identify and attract passive and active candidates using Boolean searches, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, and referral networks.

• Database & Pipeline Management: Experience in building and maintaining an organized talent pipeline to support ongoing recruitment needs.

• Technology Proficiency: Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing tools.

• Speed & Efficiency: Strong ability to source and submit 50-100 qualified candidates per week, meeting hiring demands.

• Communication & Candidate Engagement: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills to conduct initial outreach and pre-screening.

• Data Accuracy & ATS Management: Ability to maintain 100% accuracy in candidate records, ensuring all relevant details are updated.

• Collaboration & Teamwork: Ability to work effectively with offshore recruiters and onshore hiring teams to prioritize sourcing needs.

• Results-Driven: Ability to meet weekly and monthly sourcing targets while maintaining high-quality candidate submissions.

• Problem-Solving & Adaptability: Ability to adjust sourcing strategies based on market trends and hiring demands.

title: Marketing Executive – UK - Remote
description:
About the role

We are looking for a practical, creative Marketing Specialist to manage marketing activity across BearTOOLS and Bear Safety.

BearTOOLS provides workplace safety products and accessories, while Bear Safety focuses on automated industrial safety solutions. This role combines digital marketing, content creation and graphic design with website management, Amazon product launches and product development support.

You will take work from the initial brief through to delivery and performance review, working closely with sales, leadership, suppliers, freelancers and external partners. The role suits someone who enjoys varied work, can organise their priorities independently and is comfortable moving between creative tasks and data analysis.

Key responsibilities

Marketing planning and campaign management

• Plan and maintain a marketing calendar across both brands.

• Coordinate campaigns around product launches, events and sales priorities.

• Create and manage HubSpot
 campaigns, including copy, design, audience segments, scheduling and reporting.

• Set up, monitor and optimise Google Ads campaigns within agreed budgets.

• Review results and recommend improvements that support enquiries, sales and business growth.

Social media and content

• Plan, create and schedule content for LinkedIn,
, Instagram and TikTok.

• Write captions, blogs, website copy, product descriptions and other marketing content.

• Create graphics, carousels and short videos suited to each platform.

• Apply basic SEO principles and coordinate specialist work with freelancers.

• Maintain a consistent brand voice and accurate product information across channels.

Website management and reporting

• Publish and update blogs, product information and other website content using Webflow CMS and Shopify.

• Check page formatting, images, links and mobile layouts.

• Use Google Analytics and Google Search Console to review traffic, engagement and search performance.

• Report against agreed KPIs and identify practical opportunities for improvement.

• Participate in weekly sales and marketing meetings and quarterly reviews, preparing updates and presentations.

Graphic design and creative production

• Create original graphics for campaigns, sales materials and requests from the team.

• Develop catalogues and brochures from scratch, including structure, copywriting, page layout and final artwork.

• Design presentations for sales, events and internal meetings.

• Create product packaging, labels, datasheets and supporting artwork.

• Edit product photographs and videos for websites, social media and Amazon.

• Prepare production-ready files and maintain organised source files and approved versions.

Bear Safety artwork and event support

• Create bespoke projection and signage artwork.

• Produce projection mock-ups on customer photographs to illustrate proposed solutions.

• Use SketchUp to develop event stand layouts and visual mock-ups.

• Prepare exhibition graphics, invitations, presentations and promotional materials.

• Coordinate artwork requirements and deadlines with colleagues and suppliers.

Product development support

• Communicate with suppliers about product specifications, branding, packaging and samples.

• Request quotations, minimum order quantities and lead times.

• Coordinate sample feedback and document agreed changes.

• Prepare product specifications, datasheets, packaging and label artwork.

• Keep product information consistent across supplier documents, sales materials and marketing content.

Amazon product launches and listing management

• Research competitors, pricing, product features and positioning using Amazon and Jungle Scout.

• Write listing titles, bullet points and descriptions.

• Create listing images and A+ content.

• Upload assets and update content through Amazon Seller Central.

• Check listings for errors, missing content and opportunities for improvement.

• Set up promotions using agreed products, dates and discounts.

• Coordinate with account contacts on issues requiring additional support.

Partner and freelancer coordination

• Brief freelancers, review deliverables and coordinate feedback.

• Work with industry affiliations and other partners on relevant content, events and marketing opportunities.

• Maintain clear communication on deadlines, progress and next steps.

Skills and experience

• Demonstrable experience delivering digital marketing campaigns and creative content.

• Practical experience with Google Ads,
 marketing, social media and basic SEO.

• Strong graphic design skills, including creating artwork from scratch and preparing files for print.

• Ability to write clear, accurate copy in British English.

• Experience designing presentations and editing marketing videos.

• Confidence interpreting performance data and turning findings into useful actions.

• Strong organisation and attention to detail when managing work across multiple brands.

• Ability to work independently in a remote setting and collaborate effectively with colleagues and external partners.

• Willingness to learn technical products and communicate their features clearly.

Tools and platforms

The role uses the following tools. Please indicate your level of experience with each in your application.

• Marketing and reporting: HubSpot, Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Search Console and Buffer.

• Design and video: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Lightroom, Premiere Pro and Canva.

• Websites: Webflow CMS and Shopify.

• E-commerce: Amazon Seller Central and Jungle Scout.

• Event visualisation: SketchUp.

• AI support: ChatGPT for research assistance, ideas and drafting, with outputs checked for accuracy.

Strong Photoshop and Illustrator skills are important. Basic working knowledge of Webflow, Shopify and Amazon Seller Central is suitable for routine content tasks.

Useful additional experience

• Marketing for B2B, industrial, safety or technical products.

• Supporting product development and communicating with overseas suppliers.

• Creating Amazon A+ content and product launch assets.

• Designing packaging, catalogues and exhibition materials.

• Producing event stand concepts in SketchUp.

Monitor key advertising metrics



Help identify which creative concepts are performing best



Produce regular performance reports

Spot trends and opportunities from campaign results



Feed performance insights back into the creative process

Maintain creative testing libraries



Help manage content and production schedules



Assist with campaign and marketing projects



Support the wider team with administrative tasks



Help keep internal marketing systems and documents up to date



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is creative, commercially minded, organised and obsessed with improving their work.



Ideally, you'll have:



Experience editing short-form video



Experience creating video specifically for paid advertising



Strong understanding of TikTok and Meta creative formats



Experience using CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar



A strong understanding of hooks, pacing and attention retention



Good visual judgement and attention to detail



An interest in performance marketing and advertising



Comfortable working with spreadsheets and performance data



Strong written and spoken English



Excellent organisation and time management



Ability to work independently in a remote environment



A proactive attitude and willingness to test new ideas



Experience With Any of These Is a Bonus



Meta Ads



TikTok Ads



Direct-response advertising



Lead generation



UGC advertising



Performance creative



Copywriting for advertisements



AI video/image generation tools



Google Analytics or other analytics platforms



What We Offer



Full-time remote position



Work with a growing UK-based performance marketing company



Competitive salary



Performance-based incentives



Long-term opportunity to grow with the business



Training and development



Exposure to paid advertising, creative strategy and lead generation



Work directly with experienced media buyers and marketing specialists



Opportunity to take ownership of the creative function as the company grows



International remote working environment



Who We're Looking For



This role is ideal for someone who wants to understand why advertising works, not just how to edit a video.



You could be taking a winning ad, creating five new variations, reviewing the performance data and then using those insights to develop the next batch of creatives.



We're looking for someone who can combine creativity + speed + attention to detail + commercial thinking.



If you're excited by the idea of seeing your work directly influence advertising performance and lead generation, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply Now

title: Ecommerce Bookkeeper for US Supplement Brand (Shopify, Stripe, PayPal, Amazon)
description:
We are a US company running a 7-figure online supplement brand. Most of our revenue comes from subscriptions with recurring billing.



We are looking for a bookkeeper who keeps our books clean and closes every month on time. This is ongoing, long-term work.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Categorize and reconcile every transaction, every month

- Sources: Shopify, CheckoutChamp, Stripe, PayPal, Amazon Seller Central and a US business bank account

- Reconcile payment processor payouts, including fees, refunds, chargebacks and reserves

- Match supplier invoices and contractor payments

- Check warehouse (3PL) invoices against our order data before we pay them

- Track cost of goods, fulfillment costs, processing fees, refunds and chargebacks

- Close the month in QuickBooks Online or Xero within 10 days

- Fill a fixed monthly report that we provide



This role does not include tax filing. We already have an accountant for taxes.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Real experience doing the books for an online store that sells physical products

- Experience with subscriptions or recurring billing

- You have reconciled Stripe and PayPal payouts yourself, many times

- You understand inventory and landed cost

- You check numbers before you trust them, and you ask when something is unclear

- Good written English



If you have only done bookkeeping for service businesses or local shops, this job is not a good fit.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send us a message here. We do not read applications sent through OnlineJobs.



The only way to apply is to take our skills test at this link:







About the test:

- It takes up to 25 minutes

- It uses real bookkeeping calculations from a month like ours

- Use a computer, not a phone

- The test is monitored by an automatic security check

- You tell us your rate at the end of the test



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. Skills test at the link above

2. The best results get a second, practical test

3. Short video call

4. Paid trial on one month of real data



We only contact candidates who pass the test.

title: Accounting Operations Specialist
description:
Title: Accounting Operations Specialist

Company: Team Integrity Knowledge Center (TIKC) & Integrity Global Logistics (IGL)

Type: Full-Time (Remote)

Schedule: Monday–Friday (10-2 pm CST Hours Required | Flexibility for Executive Needs)



About Team Integrity Knowledge Center (TIKC) & Integrity Global Logistics (IGL)

Team Integrity Knowledge Center (TIKC) is a premier government contracting consulting and education firm that helps small businesses build, grow, and scale through strategic positioning, certifications, and contract readiness.

Integrity Global Logistics (IGL) is a minority women-owned logistics firm delivering transportation and supply chain solutions within the government and commercial sectors.

Together, these organizations operate at the intersection of strategy, execution, and opportunity, supporting businesses and agencies in navigating the government marketplace.

At the center of both is a CEO driving vision, partnerships, and growth—this role exists to protect, structure, and multiply that leadership capacity.



Role Overview

This role sits at the intersection of bookkeeping, basic accounting, and financial operations. You are responsible for keeping clean, accurate books and supporting smarter financial decisions through basic accounting insight and modern tools.

This is not a “data entry” role. You are expected to leverage automation, AI, and financial systems (including Stripe and QuickBooks) to increase accuracy, speed, and visibility.

If you’re still doing everything manually—you’re already behind.



Key Responsibilities

Financial Recordkeeping & Accuracy

Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records across all entities

Record daily financial transactions (AP, AR, payroll, expenses)

Perform weekly and monthly reconciliations (bank, credit card, Stripe accounts)

Maintain a clean and scalable chart of accounts



Accounts Payable & Receivable (Stripe-Driven Operations)

Manage invoicing and payment collection through Stripe and other systems

Monitor incoming payments, payouts, and processing fees

Reconcile Stripe transactions with QuickBooks

Track outstanding invoices and actively follow up on receivables

Process vendor payments and maintain proper documentation



Basic Accounting Functions

Assist with monthly close process

Prepare and review Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow reports

Categorize expenses correctly for tax and reporting purposes

Support budgeting and forecasting activities

Identify financial discrepancies and resolve them proactively

Assist with journal entries and accruals as needed



Government Contracting Compliance Support

Maintain audit-ready financial records at all times

Track contract-specific income and expenses accurately

Support documentation requirements for audits, grants, and funding

Ensure financial processes align with compliance expectations



AI & Automation Integration

Leverage AI tools to streamline bookkeeping tasks, categorization, and reporting

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive financial workflows

Use AI to assist with financial analysis, anomaly detection, and forecasting support

Continuously improve efficiency—manual work should be minimized wherever possible



Systems & Process Management

Own and maintain QuickBooks as the source of truth

Ensure proper integration between Stripe, banking, and accounting systems

Document and follow SOPs (aligned with Trainual)

Maintain organized, secure financial records



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

100% accurate reconciliations across all accounts (including Stripe)

Invoices issued within 24–48 hours

Reduction in outstanding receivables (improved cash collection)

Monthly close completed on time

Increased automation and reduced manual processing over time

Audit-ready books at all times



Qualifications

3+ years of bookkeeping or accounting experience

Hands-on experience with QuickBooks (required)

Experience using Stripe (strongly preferred)

Familiarity with AI tools or willingness to adopt them quickly

Basic understanding of accounting principles (GAAP knowledge is a plus)

Experience in logistics, service-based businesses, or government contracting is a plus



Core Competencies

Strong attention to detail (errors cost money—period)

Financial organization and discipline

Proactive communication and problem-solving

Tech-savvy with a systems-first mindset

Ability to adapt in a fast-growth environment



Work Environment & Expectations

Remote or hybrid flexibility

Must be responsive and deadline-driven

Expected to collaborate across departments

Growth-oriented environment—systems and processes will evolve



What Success Looks Like in This Role

Financials are clean, current, and trusted

Leadership has real-time visibility into cash flow

Stripe, QuickBooks, and banking systems are fully aligned

Manual work is reduced through smart automation and AI

The company is always prepared for audits, funding, and contract growth



Compensation

Competitive based on experience

Growth potential as financial operations expand



If you want to tighten this even more, the next move is building a non-negotiables checklist (what disqualifies a candidate instantly) and a skills test using your real Stripe + QuickBooks data—that’s where you separate someone who “knows bookkeeping” from someone who can actually run your financial engine.







Ideal Candidate Traits

Quickbooks and accounting certifications 

Previous transportation and logistics experience

Previous US government account management 

Government bookkeeping compliance 

US and offshore payroll management

US based subcontractor account management 

Highly proactive and anticipatory

Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and US-based accounting needs

Strategic thinker with operational execution skills

Detail-oriented with high-level awareness

Calm under pressure and solution-focused

Loyal, trustworthy, and aligned with leadership vision

Able to move fast while maintaining accuracy and structure



Why This Role Matters

This role is the force multiplier behind the CEO.

By creating structure, managing priorities, and ensuring execution, you allow leadership to operate at the highest level—focusing on vision, partnerships, revenue, and impact.

When done well, this role directly influences:

Business growth across TIKC and IGL

Execution of strategic initiatives

Increased efficiency and decision-making speed

Strengthened relationships with partners, clients, and stakeholders

This is not just support—it is strategic leadership enablement.

title: QuickBooks Bookkeeper – Cleanup & Catch-Up Specialist
description:
# QuickBooks Bookkeeper – Cleanup & Catch-Up Specialist



Employment: Full-Time | 40 Hours per Week



Experience: Minimum 2 Years of Professional Bookkeeping and QuickBooks Experience



About the Position



We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented QuickBooks Bookkeeper to join our growing team.



This position focuses primarily on historical bookkeeping cleanups and catch-up projects, helping businesses restore accuracy to financial records that may have been neglected, mismanaged, or incorrectly maintained for several years.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online and is confident identifying, investigating, and resolving complex bookkeeping discrepancies.

Key Responsibilities



- Perform comprehensive bookkeeping cleanups involving multiple years of incomplete, disorganized, or inaccurate financial records.

- Review, reconcile, and correct historical transactions in QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Desktop.

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and other balance sheet accounts across multiple accounting periods.

- Identify and resolve duplicate transactions, uncategorized expenses, missing entries, and financial discrepancies.

- Review and correct general ledgers, charts of accounts, and transaction classifications.

- Investigate discrepancies between bank statements and recorded financial activity.

- Prepare accurate Profit & Loss Statements, Balance Sheets, and other financial reports.

- Maintain organized documentation of corrections, reconciliations, and completed cleanup work.

- Communicate progress, challenges, and outstanding issues clearly and proactively.

- Follow established company procedures, meet project deadlines, and maintain consistently high standards of accuracy.



Minimum Qualifications

- At least 2 years of hands-on QuickBooks experience, including proficiency with QuickBooks Online.

- Demonstrated experience completing historical bookkeeping cleanups and catch-up projects.

- Strong understanding of accounting principles, general ledger management, account reconciliation, and financial reporting.

- Ability to identify and independently resolve complicated bookkeeping errors.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote working environment.

- Ability to work a consistent 40-hour schedule and meet deadlines.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience cleaning up two or more years of historical bookkeeping records.

- Experience managing multiple client bookkeeping projects simultaneously.

- Experience working with US-based businesses and accounting practices.

- QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification.

- Experience preparing financial records for CPA or tax professional review.



The Qualities We Value



1. Accuracy & Attention to Detail



You take pride in producing accurate financial records. You investigate discrepancies thoroughly and verify your work before marking projects complete.



2. Reliability & Punctuality



You consistently arrive on time, communicate your availability, honor commitments, and complete assigned work within established deadlines.

- Potential for increased responsibility based on demonstrated performance.



How to Apply



We will send you a WhatsApp message once you apply, where we will ask for a quick video describing your experience.

title: Senior Accountant/Controller ($4,500/mo + 13th Month + PTO)
description:
Most controller titles offered from the Philippines are a bookkeeping queue with a better name. This one is the real seat. You will be the financial authority for business groups with up to $30 million in revenue, and you will still do your own bank recs.



Who we are



We are a US accounting and tax firm. We have worked with business owners since 1991, and most of our accounting work is for multi-unit franchise groups: owners with ten, twenty or more stores, each in its own entity, closing on the franchise system's period calendar.



You would work directly with us. No agency in the middle, no account manager speaking for you, and nobody billing your hours to a client you are never allowed to talk to.



The seat



You are the controller for a group of our largest franchise clients. When an owner asks whether they can afford the next store, or what the bank will see in the covenant test, you are the person who knows. Not because you read a summary someone else prepared. Because you built the numbers.



What you own:



The close and the financial statements. Every period, on the franchise system's calendar, which for most of our clients means a 13-period year. Statements the owner can use, ready when promised.

Budgets and cash forecasts. You tell the owner what the next quarter looks like before it arrives.

Lender and covenant reporting. You run the covenant calculations and you know where each group stands against its loan terms before the bank does.

Internal controls. Over cash and payables, store by store. You find the gap before it becomes a loss.

Store purchases and sales. You read the closing documents, book the purchase price allocation, set up or retire the assets and intangibles, and produce the numbers a buyer or a lender will ask for.

The owner relationship. You are the owner's main financial contact. You explain the numbers on a call, plainly, and you send weekly reports to the clients who get them. Every week, without a reminder.



You still do the work



This is not an advisory role and it is not a management role. The person in this seat does bank reconciliations.

You reconcile the accounts yourself. Groups with dozens of bank accounts across dozens of entities. You find every difference and you prove it. You do not plug it, and you do not book a balancing entry to make it go away.

You book the hard entries yourself. Franchise fees and the intangibles they create, their amortization, and activity between related entities.

You review newer staff within 48 hours and send their work back with notes they can learn from.

You train. When a newer accountant asks how a client works, you show them that day.

You write it down. Every client you run has a current written procedure: how its bank feeds work and which entries are unusual to it.



If a controller title means you stopped touching reconciliations years ago, this is the wrong seat. We want someone who can explain a covenant test to an owner at ten in the morning and find a $312 difference in a bank rec at eleven.



The grunt work is going away. You help us retire it



We are rolling out AI tools over the coming months, and bank reconciliation matching is first on the list. The aim is to take the repetitive work off your desk so your hours go to the judgment calls.



You will help us test these tools on real clients. That means using them, telling us where they get things wrong, and checking every number they produce until we trust them. You do not need prior experience with AI. You need to want it, and you need to stay skeptical of it.



Hours



You work Philippine hours with a fixed overlap into the US Eastern morning, 7 to 11am Eastern. Owners call in that window and our team meets in it. We agree the rest of your day with you and then we keep to it.



Pay and Benefits



$4,500 USD per month

Plus 13th month pay. Uncommon in a contractor arrangement. We pay it anyway

Unlimited paid time off. The statutory floor in this country is five days a year. We do not count yours at all, and we expect you to spend it

Philippine daytime hours with one agreed US overlap window

Philippine public holidays observed. You work your country's calendar, not ours

Signing bonus to cover a second monitor, UPS, or generator

US CPA or EA sponsorship if you want it. We pay the fees and give you study time

That is the top of what this market pays a controller on US accounts, and we set it there on purpose. We want the best person available, and we do not want to lose them the moment somebody else makes an offer.



What you bring



At least eight years of accounting for US clients, with at least three of them owning the full close and financial reporting for a multi-entity group, as controller or in practice

Franchise or other multi-unit experience: many entities under one owner, with numbers that have to tie

Hands-on experience with store or business acquisitions and sales: closing documents, purchase price allocation, intangibles and amortization

Budgets, cash forecasts and loan covenant reporting you have built yourself

Bank reconciliations you have done yourself in the last twelve months

Experience reviewing other accountants' work and training newer staff

Thomson Reuters Accounting CS. If your command is in another professional package, say which and we will talk. QuickBooks Online and ShareFile are useful

A record of logging your time on every task, because some of our clients are billed on it

English strong enough to explain a set of financial statements to a US business owner on a live call

A stable home setup and the discipline to run your own day

A Philippine CPA or progress toward a US CPA is a plus. It is not required.



How we work



Read this part twice. We hire for it with the same weight as the technical skills above.

No task is beneath the seat. The controller does reconciliations. The title does not change that.

We change how we work, often. We are rebuilding the firm around automation, and processes that worked last year get replaced. When a new process arrives, you try it in good faith. If you think it is wrong, you say so in writing to the person who owns it, with your reasons, and then you follow the decision.

Your knowledge belongs on paper. Being the only person who knows how a client works is not job security here. It is a risk to the client, and we treat it as one.

Disagree with the work, never with the person. Problems go to the right person, privately, in a normal tone. We do not settle disagreements in the team chat.

You own your deadlines. If one is going to slip, you tell us before it slips, not after.

Verify, do not guess. A number you cannot support is not finished, however close the deadline is.



Your first 90 days



Days 1 to 30: You learn our systems and shadow the accountant who runs each client today through one full period close. By day 30 you have run one close yourself with review, bank recs included.

Days 31 to 60: You run your clients' closes and reconciliations yourself, weekly reports included. Every client you hold has a written procedure, written or updated by you. You have had a first financial review call with each owner.

Days 61 to 90: Each of your groups has a cash forecast and, where it has a loan, a covenant calculation you built. You are reviewing newer staff within 48 hours. You have tested our first AI reconciliation tool on at least one of your clients and told us what it gets wrong.



To apply



Apply through this form: 



It takes about 20 minutes, and your answers are the first thing we read.



Do not
 or apply through OLJ

Availability is essential.



You must be able to handle time-sensitive bookkeeping tasks and communicate with clients, vendors, and team members during designated hours between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. Pacific Time. This is particularly important for invoicing, bill payments, collections, and other tasks that cannot always wait until the next business day.



The Person We're Looking For



Skills matter. Mindset matters more.



You're someone who:



• Takes responsibility for commitments and follows through.

• Communicates openly, honestly, and proactively.

• Takes initiative instead of waiting for instructions.

• Investigates problems and looks for answers before escalating them.

• Notices inconsistencies and cares enough to resolve them.

• Creates order, maintains organized records, and looks for ways to improve processes.

• Thinks critically and exercises good judgment.

• Understands the importance of accuracy, confidentiality, and trust.

• Is comfortable learning new tools and adapting as the company grows.

• Takes pride in doing excellent work, even when no one is watching.

• Wants to build a long-term working relationship rather than pursue a temporary freelance project.



If your first instinct when something doesn't look right is:



“I'll investigate and make sure it's accurate.”

—you may be exactly who we're looking for.



Compensation and Growth



The starting compensation is $5 USD per hour for the first 90 days, with an initial commitment of approximately five hours per week. 



Performance-based increases may be considered based on the quality and accuracy of your work, reliability, initiative, and overall contribution to the business. Increases are not automatic or guaranteed.



We're a growing company, and our needs will evolve. We're looking for someone who can establish a strong foundation, earn trust through consistent performance, and grow with us as opportunities develop.



A Note About Working at Beckon



As a startup, we sometimes wear multiple hats. From time to time, that means helping beyond the traditional boundaries of a role when the needs of the business call for it.



We value team members who understand the bigger picture, communicate openly, and are willing to contribute where they can make the greatest difference.



That doesn't mean doing everything. It means taking ownership, using good judgment, and caring about the success of the team.



We're building more than a business. We're building the systems, relationships, and culture that will support its long-term success.



We want people who are excited to be part of that journey.



Attention to Detail: Application Requirement



To demonstrate that you've read this entire job description, begin your application with the word “Outstanding.”

Applications that do not begin with this word may not be considered.



How to Apply



Please submit your application with:



• A brief introduction about yourself and your bookkeeping experience.

• A summary of your QuickBooks experience and the types of U.S. businesses you've supported.

• A description of your experience with bank reconciliations, financial statements, and month-end closing.

• Confirmation that you can handle time-sensitive tasks during the required Pacific Time availability window.

• Your confirmation that the starting compensation and initial weekly hours work for you.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a trusted part of Beckon's team for years—not someone looking for just another short-term project.



If you're experienced, dependable, detail-oriented, and excited to help build something with long-term potential, we want to hear from you.



Outstanding candidates don't just keep the books. They take ownership of getting the numbers right.

title: Youtube Video Editor / Website Design / Social Media
description:
About the Brand



I am launching Safe Travels with Steve, a travel YouTube channel, podcast, and website designed to help people explore the world with greater confidence.



As a retired police commander and experienced traveler, I combine practical safety knowledge with a love of adventure. The content will feature destinations, cruises, travel tips, gear, and real-world experiences—helping people travel smarter while enjoying everything the world has to offer.



I am looking for a creative, reliable, and organized professional to help turn my footage and ideas into engaging content and manage the channel’s day-to-day operations. My role is to travel, appear on camera, and provide content and direction. Your role is to help bring that content to life and keep production moving.



Primary Responsibilities:



Video Editing and Content Production



Edit raw footage into engaging, professional YouTube videos with clear storytelling and strong pacing.



Improve audio, adjust color, add captions, and incorporate appropriate graphics, music, and B-roll.



Create YouTube Shorts and repurpose content for Instagram Reels and
.



Design compelling thumbnails that accurately represent each video.



Organize footage, project files, and finished content so everything is easy to locate.



Use properly licensed music, images, and other assets.



YouTube Channel Management



Maintain a content calendar and consistent publishing schedule.



Upload and schedule videos, including titles, descriptions, chapters, captions, playlists, and end screens.



Recommend topics, hooks, and improvements based on audience interests and channel performance.



Monitor analytics and provide a simple report on results and opportunities.



Respond to routine comments in the brand’s voice, encourage meaningful discussion, and flag questions that require my input.



Manage community posts and help build an active, engaged audience.



Help prepare, launch, and manage channel memberships when available, including member communications, benefits, and exclusive content.



Support future sponsorships, affiliate links, and other revenue opportunities.



Additional Responsibilities Based on Your Skills



Ideally, the same person can also provide some administrative and website support. Please be clear about which of these you can confidently handle:



Manage tasks, calendars, files, and project deadlines.



Research destinations, travel products, potential sponsors, and content ideas.



Organize incoming business inquiries and prepare draft responses.



Help build and maintain a professional website using WordPress or another suitable platform.



Publish videos, articles, travel resources, and updates on the website.



Help set up

YouTube management and video editing are the priorities. Advanced website development is a bonus, not a requirement. Workload and priorities will be agreed upon based on your availability and strengths.



What I Am Looking For

Strong written English and clear communication.



Proficiency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or comparable editing software.

Willingness to have scheduled check-ins with me during mutually agreed hours. I am based in California.



Travel content experience, podcast editing, website development,
 marketing, and membership management are especially welcome.



I value honest communication and thoughtful work. I am looking for someone who will take ownership, ask good questions, and help build a lasting brand. We will grow through useful content and authentic engagement—no purchased followers, fake views, or spam tactics.



Schedule and Compensation

title: Children's Coloring & Activity Book Designer | Amazon KDP Specialist
description:
Company: The Creative Cue  

Position: Children's Coloring & Activity Book Designer / Amazon KDP Specialist  

Location: Remote  

Opportunity: Long-Term Collaboration



About Us



The Creative Cue is a growing children's brand focused on creating fun, engaging, and educational products that inspire creativity, imagination, and learning.



We are expanding our collection of children's coloring books, activity books, tracing workbooks, and other educational materials for preschool and elementary-age children.



Our goal is to develop a recognizable brand known for high-quality, professionally designed books that parents love and children enjoy.



We are looking for a talented, creative, detail-oriented designer who can help us bring our ideas to life and manage the book production process from concept to completion.



Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced **Children's Activity Book Designer with Amazon KDP expertise** who can independently develop professional, engaging, and print-ready books.



Our initial goal is to develop a collection of 12+ unique children's books, with additional projects as our brand grows.



The ideal candidate understands children's educational content, illustration, workbook layouts, Amazon KDP requirements, and quality control.



This is not simply a Canva design position. We need someone who takes ownership of projects and delivers accurate, polished, publication-ready books.



Key Responsibilities



Book Creation & Design

- Design original children's coloring books, educational workbooks, tracing books, and activity books.

- Create engaging illustrations appropriate for specific age groups.

- Develop activities covering letters, numbers, shapes, colors, counting, matching, and early learning.

- Maintain consistent illustration styles, typography, page layouts, and branding.

- Create professional front and back covers.

- Develop unique book concepts while following our established creative direction.



Amazon KDP Formatting

- Prepare interiors for Amazon KDP paperback publishing.

- Create true high-resolution artwork, targeting 300 DPI or vector-quality output.

- Format books to specific trim sizes, including 8.5 × 11 inches.

- Understand bleed, no-bleed, safe margins, gutters, and spine calculations.

- Deliver properly formatted print-ready PDF files.

- Prepare complete paperback cover files using final book specifications.

- Review files for potential printing and formatting issues before submission.



Educational Content & Quality Control

- Ensure all activities are age-appropriate and educationally accurate.

- Verify correct spelling, alphabet sequencing, number placement, and tracing exercises.

- Check every page for missing elements, inconsistencies, or printing issues.

- Follow approved designs without making unauthorized changes.

- Perform a complete quality review before presenting a book for approval.



Project Management & Deliverables

- Manage several book projects efficiently.

- Organize design files, illustrations, and completed books.

- Communicate project progress and timelines.

- Provide editable source files and final PDF deliverables.

- Incorporate feedback accurately and promptly.

- Help establish templates and repeatable processes to streamline future book production.



Required Qualifications



- Proven experience creating children's coloring books, activity books, or educational workbooks.

- Demonstrated experience preparing paperback books for Amazon KDP.

- Strong skills in Canva, Adobe Illustrator, Affinity Designer, InDesign, or comparable design software.

- Understanding of vector illustrations, print resolution, and professional page formatting.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Strong written English skills, particularly for educational instructions.

- Ability to maintain consistency across 50–100-page projects.

- Ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines.

- Willingness to take ownership of projects from beginning to end.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience designing preschool or homeschooling materials.

- Familiarity with early childhood learning concepts.

- Experience producing multiple books within a consistent brand identity.

- Ability to create product mockups and Amazon listing images.

- Experience preparing digital printable products for Shopify.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted illustration workflows and correcting generated artwork for professional publishing.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is creative, organized, reliable, and extremely detail-oriented.



We value accuracy just as much as creativity.



The right person understands that a beautiful book cover is only the beginning. Every interior page must be consistent, functional, educationally appropriate, and professionally prepared for printing.



We want someone who identifies and corrects problems before submitting work, rather than relying on us to find mistakes.



Application Instructions



To apply, please provide:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Three examples of children's coloring books or activity books you have personally designed.

3. Examples of complete book interiors, not just covers.

4. Details of your experience with Amazon KDP formatting and publishing requirements.

5. The design software you use.

6. Your typical process for completing a 60-page children's activity book.

7. Your availability and estimated turnaround time for completing a full book.



Important: Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid design assessment using our existing brand guidelines and sample illustrations.



Why Join The Creative Cue?



This is an opportunity to work with a growing children's brand and help develop an expanding catalog of educational and creative products.



We are looking to build a long-term working relationship with someone who takes pride in their work, communicates well, and consistently delivers high-quality results.



If you enjoy creating products that help children learn, explore, and have fun, we'd love to hear from you.



We look forward to reviewing your portfolio!



The Creative Cue

AI Creative Video Editor — AI Animation, Claymation, UGC & Performance Ads



We're a fast-growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) supplement brand looking for a highly creative AI Video Editor who can produce unique, engaging, scroll-stopping ads for Meta 
/Instagram) and TikTok.



We're not looking for someone who can only put clips together. We want someone who knows how to use AI to create entirely new styles of content, experiment with different creative concepts, and turn ideas into high-performing advertisements.



You should be comfortable creating everything from 3D animations, Pixar-style videos, claymations, AI singing videos, podcast-style ads, talking heads, realistic AI UGC, and AI-generated footage mixed with real-life clips.



The ideal candidate is someone who stays up to date with the latest AI tools, enjoys experimenting with new creative formats, and can consistently produce high-quality ads quickly.



We're looking to hire very soon, and both full-time and part-time opportunities are available.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



AI Animation: Create Pixar-style animations, 3D animations, cartoon-style videos, and animated product advertisements.



Claymation: Produce creative claymation-style videos with animated characters, products, and storytelling.



AI Singing Videos: Create AI-generated characters or people singing, with realistic lip-syncing, music, and engaging visuals.



Podcast & Talking Head Ads: Generate realistic AI podcast conversations, interviews, doctor-style talking heads, and educational videos.



AI + Real Footage: Seamlessly combine AI-generated scenes with real UGC clips, stock footage, product shots, and existing video content.



AI UGC: Create realistic AI-generated selfie-style videos, influencer-style content, and scripted testimonial-style advertisements using tools like HeyGen, Veo, Kling, and similar platforms.



Product Animations: Create engaging animated product demonstrations, explainer videos, and visual storytelling.



Video Editing: Edit short-form ads with strong hooks, fast pacing, captions, transitions, sound effects, music, and B-roll.



Static Ads: Design high-quality AI-generated image ads and creative variations using Nano Banana, Gemini, Midjourney, Photoshop, or Canva.



Creative Testing: Produce multiple variations of winning concepts, including different hooks, visuals, characters, scripts, and formats.



AI Voiceovers: Generate realistic voiceovers, character dialogue, and sound effects using ElevenLabs or similar tools.



You'll be expected to experiment with different styles and continuously introduce fresh creative ideas instead of producing the same types of ads repeatedly.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Someone who can start very soon.



At least 1 year of experience editing short-form videos.



Strong experience using AI video generation and image generation tools.



Ability to create multiple AI video styles, not just basic AI talking heads.



Experience with tools such as Veo, Kling, Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Nano Banana, Gemini, and Midjourney.



Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or After Effects.



Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling, and what makes people stop scrolling.



Ability to make AI-generated videos look polished, realistic, and natural when needed.



Ability to blend AI content with real footage seamlessly.



Creative mindset with the ability to bring new concepts and ideas to the table.



Fast turnaround times without sacrificing quality.



Reliable communication and ability to follow briefs accurately.



Good written English.



Reliable computer and stable internet connection.



BONUS POINTS



Experience creating direct-response ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.



Experience advertising supplements, health, or wellness products.



Ability to create claymation, Pixar-style animations, and realistic AI characters.



Experience creating viral-style AI singing videos or animated skits.



Strong understanding of Meta and TikTok ad creative.



Ability to write your own hooks, scripts, and creative concepts.



Experience creating both video ads and static image ads.



Understanding of what makes an advertisement convert, not just look visually appealing.



HOURS & SETUP



Looking for someone who can start very soon.



Full-time or part-time positions available, depending on experience, availability, and skill level.



Long-term opportunity for the right person.



100% remote.



Some overlap with US working hours preferred.



We're looking for someone reliable, creative, and interested in growing with the brand.



PAY



Starting compensation based on experience and skill level.



Rate discussed during the interview.



Performance review after 90 days.



Opportunities for raises and performance bonuses based on creative performance.



HOW TO APPLY



We will not review generic or copy-paste applications.



Change your subject line to: "I Create Scroll-Stopping AI Ads"



Send your portfolio with your 3–5 best AI-generated video advertisements.



Include examples of different AI creative styles you've produced (animation, claymation, singing, talking heads, AI + real footage, etc.).



List the AI tools you've used and explain which types of videos you've created with them.



Tell us what makes an AI-generated advertisement actually convert.



Share your expected starting rate (hourly or monthly).



Include your WhatsApp number.



Let us know whether you're interested in full-time or part-time work and how soon you can start.



Important: We're prioritizing applicants who can demonstrate a wide range of AI creative abilities. We want someone who can create unique content from scratch, not just generate basic AI avatars or edit existing footage.



If you're constantly experimenting with new AI tools and love turning creative ideas into finished advertisements, we'd love to see your work.

* Qualify potential customers and schedule appointments for free estimates.

* Send brief follow-up
s when needed.

title: Website Quality Assurance (QA) & UI/UX Designer
description:
Hiring: Website QA & UI/UX Designer (Part-Time, Remote)



Company: Southwind Marketing

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Schedule: 15–20 hours per week

Compensation: $20–$25 USD per hour, based on experience

Employment Type: Part-Time, Long-Term Independent Contractor



About Southwind Marketing



Southwind Marketing is a U.S.-based, full-service marketing and communications agency serving businesses, municipalities, economic development organizations, tourism agencies, nonprofits, and other organizations nationwide.



We specialize in website design and development, digital marketing, branding, search engine optimization, and strategic communications.



We build and manage websites across multiple industries and are looking for a detail-oriented website specialist who can independently evaluate website quality, identify opportunities for improvement, and help our team create better digital experiences.



About the Role



We are looking for someone who can look at a website and immediately begin identifying what works, what doesn't, and what needs to change.



This position combines website quality assurance, UI/UX design, website auditing, and redesign recommendations.



You will work alongside our existing design and development team to ensure our websites are professional, functional, accessible, user-friendly, and ready for clients.



We are not looking for someone who simply checks whether a website loads, runs an automated scan, or produces generic AI-generated recommendations.



We want someone who understands how websites should actually work, can identify problems others overlook, and knows how to improve both the appearance and functionality of a website.



The ideal candidate can independently review an entire website, document problems, recommend specific corrections, and develop professional redesign concepts that our team can implement.



This is a hands-on position requiring strong attention to detail, independent judgment, and the ability to communicate findings clearly.



Key Responsibilities



Website Auditing & Quality Assurance



Conduct comprehensive website audits before launch and on existing client websites.



Review every accessible page to identify design, usability, content, and functionality issues.



Identify broken links, incorrect navigation, formatting issues, missing content, inconsistent layouts, and other website defects.



Evaluate navigation menus, dropdowns, breadcrumbs, buttons, forms, and interactive elements.



Test websites on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.



Verify that pages, features, and user journeys function as intended.



Identify inconsistencies between pages, including spacing, typography, imagery, colors, and branding.



Recheck corrections completed by developers to verify that issues have been resolved.



UI/UX Design & Website Redesign



Evaluate website layouts, navigation, visual consistency, and overall user experience.



Identify opportunities to improve website organization, readability, accessibility, and usability.



Develop redesign recommendations and visual mockups using Figma.



Recommend improvements to page layouts, calls to action, navigation structures, and user journeys.



Evaluate websites from the perspective of actual users and potential customers.



Collaborate with our design and development teams to improve overall website quality.



Technical Review & Optimization



Review basic technical SEO, including page titles, meta descriptions, heading structures, and internal linking.



Identify accessibility concerns and recommend improvements consistent with WCAG standards.



Evaluate website speed and performance using available testing tools.



Identify mobile responsiveness problems and browser compatibility issues.



Review calls to action, lead-generation opportunities, and conversion paths.



Identify potential website security or technical configuration concerns visible through authorized, non-invasive testing.



Reporting & Communication



Prepare comprehensive, professional website audit reports.



Include screenshots, affected URLs, descriptions of problems, and recommended corrections.



Classify findings by severity and business impact.



Create prioritized action plans for our development team.



Clearly distinguish critical issues from minor improvements.



Communicate findings in professional written English.



Independently manage assigned reviews and meet established deadlines.



Qualifications



Required:



Demonstrated experience auditing, designing, or improving professional websites.



Strong understanding of UI/UX design principles and responsive website design.



Experience using Figma to develop website layouts and mockups.



Familiarity with WordPress websites and common website development practices.



Ability to identify visual design problems and functional website defects.



Understanding of basic technical SEO and website accessibility.



Experience evaluating websites across desktop and mobile devices.



Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.



Ability to write clear, actionable website audit reports in English.



Ability to work independently without constant supervision.



Reliable internet connection and access to the tools needed to perform website evaluations.



Preferred:



Experience working with U.S.-based marketing agencies.



Experience with municipal or government websites.



Experience with e-commerce websites, including Shopify.



Knowledge of WCAG accessibility guidelines.



Familiarity with Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, Screaming Frog, or similar auditing tools.



Understanding of conversion rate optimization.



Experience reviewing websites developed by other designers or developers.



Experience creating website redesign concepts from existing websites.



Required Skills Assessment — Complete Before Applying



Every applicant must complete a website evaluation as part of the application process.



We believe demonstrated ability is more important than a résumé alone.



Rather than relying solely on interviews or portfolios, we want to see how you independently evaluate a real website.



Assessment Website







This is a staging website provided specifically for evaluating applicants.



It contains a combination of functional elements, design decisions, and potential quality concerns.



Your task is to conduct an independent evaluation and submit a professional website audit.



We are intentionally not providing a checklist of known problems. Part of this assessment is determining what deserves attention, identifying issues independently, and explaining how you would improve the website.



We want you to evaluate the entire website, not just the homepage.



Your Website Audit Must Include



1. Executive Summary



Provide your overall assessment of the website, including:



Overall website quality and professionalism.



What the website does well.



Major weaknesses or concerns.



Whether you believe the website is ready for public launch.



Your highest-priority recommendations.



2. What's Working



Identify elements that are effective and explain why they should remain.



We are not looking for an audit that simply criticizes everything. Good designers and auditors understand what should be preserved as well as what should be changed.



3. Design & User Experience



Evaluate:



Overall visual appearance and professionalism.



Branding consistency.



Typography and readability.



Colors, spacing, and alignment.



Page layouts and visual hierarchy.



Website navigation and organization.



Mobile and tablet responsiveness.



User experience and ease of navigation.



Consistency across different pages.



4. Website Functionality



Review the accessible pages and interactive elements.



Identify anything that appears broken, confusing, incomplete, inconsistent, or improperly functioning.



Explain the issue, where you found it, and how it should be corrected.



5. Technical & SEO Review



Evaluate the technical elements that can be reviewed through publicly accessible website pages and standard auditing tools.



Include:



Page titles and meta descriptions.



Heading structure.



Internal linking.



URL structure.



Image optimization concerns.



Website performance.



Mobile usability.



Technical configuration concerns.



Important: This is a staging website and is intentionally not intended for search engine indexing. Do not automatically classify its lack of search engine indexing as a defect. We expect applicants to understand the difference between development and production environments.



6. Accessibility



Identify accessibility concerns and recommend specific improvements.



Consider:



Color contrast.



Readability.



Navigation accessibility.



Image alternative text.



Form accessibility.



Keyboard accessibility where testable.



General WCAG considerations.



7. Redesign Recommendations



Explain what you would change, why you would change it, and how the proposed changes would improve the website.



We want specific design recommendations, not generic statements such as "make the website more modern" or "improve user experience."



8. Prioritized Action Plan



Organize your findings into the following categories:



Critical: Problems that prevent important functionality or create significant usability issues.



High Priority: Problems that materially affect website quality, accessibility, or user experience.



Medium Priority: Improvements that should be addressed before or shortly after launch.



Low Priority: Minor refinements, enhancements, or optional improvements.



Provide a clear recommendation for each identified issue.



9. Visual Design Sample



Using Figma, create a redesign concept for one page or section of the assessment website that you believe would benefit from improvement.



Your design should demonstrate:



Professional design judgment.



Strong visual hierarchy.



Improved usability.



Consistent branding.



Thoughtful layout decisions.



Include a brief explanation of why you made your proposed design changes.



Assessment Submission Requirements



Your submission must include:



Website Audit Report (PDF): A professional report documenting your findings across the website.



Supporting Evidence: Screenshots, page URLs, and explanations supporting your identified issues.



Actionable Recommendations: Specific corrections that a website developer could reasonably implement.



Prioritized Issue List: Findings organized by severity.



Figma Redesign Sample: A shareable link to your proposed redesign.



Time Spent: The approximate amount of time you spent completing the assessment.



We value clear, accurate, and well-organized work over unnecessary report length.



Important Assessment Instructions



You may use professional website auditing tools, browser developer tools, and other resources to assist with your evaluation.



However, we expect independent analysis, firsthand website testing, and original recommendations.



Generic automated reports, unsupported findings, and AI-generated summaries without demonstrated website inspection will not meet our standards.



Simply entering the website URL into an AI tool and submitting its output is not an acceptable assessment.



We will evaluate:



Your ability to identify actual website problems.



Your attention to detail.



Your technical understanding.



Your UI/UX design judgment.



The accuracy and usefulness of your recommendations.



Your ability to prioritize issues.



The professionalism of your report.



Your ability to communicate instructions that developers can implement.



Do not make changes to the website. This is a read-only assessment. Do not attempt to access administrative areas, bypass security controls, perform intrusive testing, or submit excessive automated requests.



We recommend limiting your initial assessment to approximately 60–90 minutes. A concise, evidence-based report is preferable to a lengthy report filled with generic observations. If selected for the next stage, you may be invited to complete a more detailed paid assessment.

- Edit business content, including product videos, promotions, brand stories, and behind-the-scenes footage.

Who I’m looking for

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or comparable editing software.

- Experience creating thumbnails and graphics using Canva, Photoshop, or similar tools.

- Good judgment about storytelling, hooks, pacing, and keeping viewers engaged.

- Strong communication, attention to detail, and dependable follow-through.

- A reliable computer and internet connection capable of handling video projects.

- Someone comfortable taking initiative and working independently once the direction is clear.

- Experience with fashion, lifestyle, entrepreneurship, product marketing, or personal brands is a plus.



How we’ll work together



We’ll agree on weekly priorities, turnaround times, and a realistic workload based on the complexity of each project. You’ll receive brand references and creative direction, with room to contribute your own ideas.



Brand assets and logos must be used exactly as provided unless a change is specifically approved. Unreleased content, business information, and account access must remain confidential.



What success looks like



Consistent, polished content that feels like me, represents my businesses well, and gets delivered on schedule. I’m looking for a teammate who takes ownership, brings ideas, and helps the content get better over time.



How to apply

1. A short introduction and why this role interests you.

2. Your portfolio, including at least two long-form videos and three short-form clips. Explain what you personally handled.

3. Examples of thumbnails or business content you’ve created.

I’m looking for someone who wants to grow with the team and take pride in what we create together.

In few weeks, you will personally work through our backlog of trial signups — calling, emailing, and demoing — to diagnose exactly where and why prospects drop off before paying. We want you to have turned that diagnosis into a repeatable, documented sales process, hit a meaningful and growing number of new paid customers per month, and be ready to hire and lead the first inside sales hire(s) to scale what works.

- Prior experience hiring and managing an SDR or inside sales team

title: Sales Lead (Head of Sales - B2B SaaS)
description:
We're looking for a highly motivated, AI-driven Sales Manager to lead global customer acquisition and recurring revenue growth for our SaaS products — Payrun (AI-enabled HRM) and 
 (AI-enabled CRM & HelpDesk). You'll own the full B2B sales cycle end-to-end: prospecting, demos, negotiation, closing, and account growth — with real autonomy to build and run your own sales function.



This role his highly synchronized with the SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist role: https://www.onlinejobs.ph/jobseekers/job/SEO-and-Digital-Marketing-Specialist--SaaS-B2B
.



This is a high-impact role reporting directly to the CEO, with the entrepreneurial upside of running your own team as the business scales.



About Us

We build and operate a portfolio of B2B SaaS products for small and medium-sized businesses: Payrun (payroll and HR management), and 
 (All in One CRM & HelpDesk solution), with roots going back to Gain Solutions AS, a technology consultancy founded in 2011 in Norway with developers and operations team in Dhaka, Bangladesh.



We're currently consolidating our three products into two, sharpening our focus on AI-first tools that SMBs actually adopt and keep using.



About the Role

In few weeks, you will personally work through our backlog of trial signups — calling, emailing, and demoing — to diagnose exactly where and why prospects drop off before paying. We want you to have turned that diagnosis into a repeatable, documented sales process, hit a meaningful and growing number of new paid customers per month, and be ready to hire and lead the first inside sales hire(s) to scale what works.



This is a remote work position, but you will report directly to CEO and will have to work with other team members from different parts of the world.



What You'll Do

- Personally own and work the trial-to-paid pipeline across our SaaS products in the first 90 days

- Diagnose conversion blockers through direct conversations with trial users — objections, pricing friction, missing features, poor onboarding

- Design and document a repeatable sales process (qualification, demo, objection handling, close) once patterns emerge

- Set up and maintain CRM pipeline tracking and forecasting

- Partner closely with product and marketing on activation, messaging, and onboarding based on what you hear from prospects

- Hire, train, and lead the first SDR/inside sales hire(s) once the process is proven

- Report pipeline health, conversion rates, and revenue progress directly to the CEO



What We're Looking For — Required

- 5+ years of experience in SaaS sales, ideally selling to small and medium-sized businesses (SMB)

- Demonstrated experience building a sales process or motion from near-zero, not just executing an existing playbook

- Comfortable being personally hands-on with outreach and demos, not just managing others, especially in the first months

- Experience with CRM tools for pipeline management

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Strong analytical instincts — comfortable digging into why deals are lost, not just tracking that they were



Preferred (Nice to Have)

- Experience selling HR/payroll, help desk, or CRM software specifically

- Experience with product-led growth (PLG) companies transitioning to a sales-assisted motion

- Prior experience hiring and managing an SDR or inside sales team

This role involves executing a comprehensive SEO & Digital Marketing strategy, managing PPC campaigns (if/when needed), and using data-driven insights to improve marketing performance.



This is a high-impact role reporting directly to the CEO, with the entrepreneurial upside of running your own team as the business scales.



About Us

We build and operate a portfolio of B2B SaaS products for small and medium-sized businesses: Payrun (payroll and HR management), and 
 (All in One CRM & HelpDesk solution), with roots going back to Gain Solutions AS, a technology consultancy founded in 2011 in Norway with developers and operations team in Dhaka, Bangladesh.



We're currently consolidating our three products into two, sharpening our focus on AI-first tools that SMBs actually adopt and keep using.



About the Role

In few weeks, you have established a clear technical SEO baseline (crawlability, indexation, site structure), and built a keyword strategy that feeds directly into what our Content Lead writes next.



As the SEO and Digital Marketing Specialist, you will be responsible for enhancing our online visibility, driving organic traffic, and optimizing our digital presence to support lead generation and business growth. - Fluent written English for reporting and cross-team communication

- Comfortable working independently and flagging issues before they become bigger problems



Preferred (Nice to Have)

- Experience managing SEO across multiple sites or brands at once

- Experience in SaaS or other B2B software companies

- Basic HTML/CSS literacy for diagnosing technical issues without needing a developer for everything

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – US Real Estate Investment Company
description:
Apex Real Estate Investment is a US real estate investment company looking for a reliable cold caller for a 2-WEEK TRIAL, with the intention to go long-term for the right person.



THE ROLE

You will call US homeowners (Texas market) from lists we provide, working from a structured call framework. This is NOT a word-for-word script — it is a framework with clear talking points for every stage of the call (opening, qualifying questions, booking the callback). Your job is NOT to sell or negotiate — it is to qualify: ask about the property's condition, find out what the homeowner wants, and book a callback with our closer.



- ~100 dials per day (manual click-to-dial, one call at a time — no autodialer)

- Tue–Fri, 4 hours per day + Saturday, 8 hours (24 hours/week), during US Central daytime hours

- Follow up with each lead up to 10 attempts over 4 weeks (we manage the list rotation)

- Log the outcome of every call in our system



WHAT WE PROVIDE

- A clear call framework with talking points for each stage of the conversation

- Fresh lead lists every day — you never run out of people to call

- Training on the framework and process before your first shift



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent. This is a PHONE role — your voice is everything.

- Your own computer, stable internet connection, and a good headset

- A quiet place to work with zero background noise — homeowners will hear everything

- Comfortable talking to strangers and handling rejection without taking it personally

- Reliable and punctual: if you say you will be on shift, you are on shift

- Previous cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment-setting experience strongly preferred

- Comfortable working from a framework rather than reading a script — you need to sound like a real person, not a robot



TO APPLY, PLEASE SEND:

1. A short introduction about yourself and your calling experience

2. A 1-minute voice recording of you reading this exactly: "Hi, is this John? Hi John, this is [Your Name] from Apex Real Estate Investment. You probably weren't expecting my call. I work with a small group of buyers in the Houston area. Did I catch you at a bad time?"

3. Your internet speed test result, plus your backup plan if your connection drops



2-week trial, 24 hours per week. $100/week to start, with room to grow. Goes long-term for the right person.
