title: Grant Writer & Grants Coordinator
description:
Grant Writer & Grants Coordinator

The Beacon Center | Remote | Full-Time or Part-Time



About The Beacon Center



The Beacon Center is a community-based nonprofit organization in Montgomery, Alabama, focused on expanding access to services that help individuals and families thrive.



Our work includes behavioral health and counseling, healthcare access and health literacy, food security, workforce development, adult education, homelessness services, violence intervention, reentry support, community partnerships, and other initiatives designed to address social determinants of health.



As The Beacon Center continues to grow, we are seeking a highly organized and skilled Grant Writer & Grants Coordinator to help identify funding opportunities, develop competitive proposals, manage grant deadlines, and strengthen our overall grants pipeline.



Position Overview



This is not simply a writing position.



We are looking for someone who can help build and manage a strong grant development system for The Beacon Center.



The ideal candidate will be able to research funding opportunities, understand complex grant requirements, develop compelling proposals, organize supporting documents, maintain deadlines, communicate what information is needed from leadership and program staff, and assist with post-award reporting.



You should be comfortable working with U.S.-based foundations, corporations, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and philanthropic funders.



Primary Responsibilities



Grant Research



Research foundation, corporate, local, state, federal, healthcare, and community funding opportunities.



Identify grants that align with The Beacon Center’s programs and strategic priorities.



Review eligibility requirements before recommending opportunities.



Maintain a pipeline of upcoming grant opportunities.



Provide brief summaries of recommended grants, including funding amount, deadline, eligibility, program alignment, required documents, match requirements if applicable, and a recommendation on whether we should pursue the opportunity.



Grant Writing



Draft letters of inquiry and full grant proposals.



Develop compelling organizational narratives.



Write needs statements, program descriptions, goals, objectives, outcomes, sustainability plans, evaluation sections, and organizational capacity statements.



Adapt existing organizational information for different funders rather than starting from scratch each time.



Ensure proposals clearly respond to the funder’s questions and scoring criteria.



Assist with grant budgets and budget narratives in coordination with leadership and finance staff.



Proofread and edit proposals before submission.



Grant Management



Maintain a centralized grant calendar.



Track application deadlines, reporting deadlines, award notifications, renewals, and follow-up dates.



Maintain organized grant folders and supporting documentation.



Create checklists for each application.



Notify leadership early when documents, signatures, budgets, data, or partner information are needed.



Maintain updated versions of commonly requested organizational documents.



Grant Reporting



Help prepare interim and final grant reports.



Track required outcomes and reporting requirements.



Work with program staff to collect program data and success stories.



Assist in maintaining documentation required by funders.



Help ensure grant commitments and reporting deadlines are not missed.



Funding Areas



The Beacon Center pursues funding related to:



Behavioral health and counseling



Mental health access



HIV prevention and healthcare access



Social determinants of health



Community health workers



Health literacy



Food insecurity



Homelessness



Housing stability



Workforce development



Adult education and GED programs



Violence prevention and intervention



Hospital-based violence intervention



Reentry and justice-involved populations



Youth and family services



Faith and community partnerships



Community development



Capital improvements and facility development



Technology and program infrastructure



Required Qualifications

title: Remote Chat Sales Setter / Lead Engagement Specialist
description:
# Remote Chat Sales Setter / Lead Engagement Specialist



Elevated Recovery is hiring a highly organized, persuasive, and emotionally intelligent Chat Sales Setter to manage conversations with prospective clients across multiple platforms.



We help men overcome compulsive pornography use and related behaviors. This role requires maturity, discretion, empathy, and comfort discussing sensitive topics directly and professionally.



## What You’ll Do



* Manage multiple active conversations across SMS, email, social media, and our CRM

* Respond quickly while keeping every conversation personal and context-aware

* Ask thoughtful questions, identify needs, and guide qualified prospects toward booking a call

* Follow up consistently with new, old, and previously unresponsive leads

* Track large numbers of leads without losing conversations or missing next steps

* Keep CRM records, notes, statuses, and follow-up dates accurate

* Handle basic questions and objections through chat without sounding scripted

* Make outbound calls when necessary to reconnect with leads or confirm appointments

* Coordinate with the sales team to ensure clean handoffs and strong show rates



## You May Be a Strong Fit If You Are



* An excellent written communicator with natural, conversational English

* Experienced in chat sales, appointment setting, lead nurturing, or online sales

* Comfortable managing many conversations at once across different platforms

* Highly organized and attentive to small details

* Able to personalize templates rather than blindly copying and pasting them

* Persistent with follow-up without becoming pushy

* Comfortable making outbound calls when chat alone is not enough

* Coachable, adaptable, and able to implement feedback quickly

* Reliable during U.S. business hours and available for at least one weekend shift

* Comfortable discussing pornography, relationships, recovery, and other sensitive subjects professionally



## This Role Is Not a Fit If You



* Frequently miss messages or forget follow-ups

* Depend entirely on scripts and struggle to think within a live conversation

* Avoid phone calls

* Become overwhelmed when managing multiple platforms or a large lead pipeline

* Need constant supervision to keep CRM records organized

* Are uncomfortable discussing pornography and recovery directly



## Schedule and Compensation



* Full-time remote position

* Approximately 40 hours per week

* U.S. working hours, including at least one weekend day

* $5 USD per hour plus performance-based commissions

* Training, scripts, feedback, and ongoing sales development provided



## How to Apply



Begin your application with the words **“CHAT SETTER”** and include:



1. A brief description of your chat sales or appointment-setting experience.

2. The largest number of leads or active conversations you have managed.

3. The platforms and CRMs you have used.

4. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

5. A one- to two-minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be effective in this role.



Then answer this sample lead message in your own words:



> “I’m interested, but I’m not ready to book a call. Can you just tell me how much it costs?”



We are looking closely at your ability to write naturally, ask good questions, stay organized, and move a conversation forward.

title: Property Manager/Vendor Coordination
description:
Location: Remote 

Core Availability: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm Eastern Time (USA) 

Compensation: up to $2,000 per month 



SteelSafe Self Storage operates storage properties across the United States. Customers rent individual storage units and shipping containers from us to store their belongings, business inventory, equipment, and other items. 



Our properties are managed remotely. When a customer moves out, we need to quickly inspect, clean, repair, and prepare that storage unit so the next customer can rent it. 



We’re hiring a Vendor Coordination/Property Manager to own that process remotely. Your main goal is simple: keep our properties Rent-Ready and get units back on the market fast. 



What you get: 

A clear scoreboard and a role that matters. 

Direct access to leadership and fast decisions. 

A system-driven operation (we run on Asana). 

Performance bonus opportunity tied to ops execution. 

High trust and real autonomy. 

Real authority. You are not here to pass problems to someone else. You have the authority to solve them and improve the systems behind them. 

Freedom earned through results. We care about outcomes, not looking busy. Own the result, get the job done, then build systems so the job demands less of you tomorrow. 



What you’ll do: 

Manage the entire unit turnover process: after a customer moves out, make sure the unit is inspected, cleaned, repaired if needed, and ready for the next customer to rent. 

Manage local Boots-On-The-Ground (BOTG) contractors who physically inspect, clean, repair, and maintain our properties. 

Assign maintenance and repair jobs, follow up until they are completed, and verify the finished work using photos or videos. 

Keep sites customer-ready: gates, locks, cameras, lighting, cleanliness, and curb appeal meet SteelSafe standards. 

Handle property projects end‑to‑end (example: order a sign, coordinate install, confirm with proof). 



What you own (outcomes): 

Median Time‑to‑Rent‑Ready (TTRR) after move‑out. 

Rent‑Ready Unit % stays high and trending up. 

Work orders are dispatched quickly, completed quickly, and closed with proof. 

BOTG tasks are completed on time with proof, and contractor records and payments stay current. 

Publish a weekly scorecard that identifies misses, drives action, and holds owners accountable. 



The authority and tools you’ll have: 

You have the authority to improve the operation: turn workflows, proof standards, BOTG and vendor performance, inspection schedules, and the systems used to keep properties Rent-Ready. 

Asana as the operating system (tasks, checklists, proof). 



This role is a fit if you: 

Take initiative. Act fast. Identify problems, make sound decisions, and act within your authority without waiting for instructions. Clear your blockers fast. Move with relentless urgency.  

Own the outcome. Delegating work doesn't delegate responsibility. When contractors fail or projects stall, find another solution and see it through.  

Deliver results, not activity. We don't measure effort, calls, or hours worked. We measure problems solved and jobs completed.  

Demand excellence. Hold yourself, your team, and contractors to high standards. Done means done right, on time, and verified.  

Communicate early. Raise problems before they become missed deadlines. No surprises, excuses, or hidden problems.  

Fix the root cause. Don't just solve today's problem. Build simple systems that prevent it from happening again.



How to Apply

Please submit:

-Your current resume.

-One example of something you personally accomplished in a previous position, including measurable results.

title: Instagram Content Researcher | Hooks, Trends, Angles
description:
We are hiring a Content Research and Ideation Assistant to help our team create stronger content each week.



This is not a random research role.

This is not a “watch pages and send links” role.



Your job is to study competitor and reference accounts, break down what is actually working, explain why it works, and turn that into usable content ideas our team can apply right away.



You will be working closely with the founder and the rest of the content team.



If you are good at spotting patterns, understanding what makes content perform, and turning research into useful ideas, this role could be a strong fit.



What You’ll Be Working On



Our company is in the credit repair, lender readiness, and business funding space.



We create content for entrepreneurs, side hustle business owners, and growth minded people who want access to capital, better approvals, and stronger financial options, but whose personal credit is blocking that path right now.



That means the content needs to do more than look good.

It needs to speak to pain, urgency, trust, leverage, funding, approvals, and transformation.



Your job is to help us find what is working in the market so our content team can build better content from it.



What You Will Be Doing



Study 3 competitor or reference Instagram accounts each week



Break down what is working in their content and why



Track things like hooks, post formats, calls to action, storytelling patterns, thumbnail styles, proof elements, emotional triggers, and conversion angles



Turn research into usable content ideas, angles, and recommendations



Submit one clean weekly intel brief every Monday by end of day



Share observations and patterns without needing to be asked



Help the founder and content team understand what to test, improve, or avoid



What We Need From You



Strong written English



Good judgment and pattern recognition



Ability to explain why content works, not just say that it works



Familiarity with Instagram, Reels, Stories, carousel content, and modern social media formats



Ability to work independently and stay organized



Reliable internet and equipment



Comfortable giving honest observations and useful pushback when something does not make sense



Bonus Points



Experience in social media management, content strategy, or marketing research



Experience supporting US based founders or teams



Understanding of credit, finance, business coaching, or personal brand content



Experience studying hooks, audience psychology, and performance patterns



Who This Role Is Best For



This role is best for someone who enjoys breaking content down, spotting patterns, and turning research into clear ideas a team can actually use.



You are probably a fit if:



You naturally notice what makes people stop scrolling



You can explain hooks, angles, and patterns clearly



You like turning messy observations into useful recommendations



You do not need daily hand holding to do good work



You can think inside your lane and bring useful ideas forward



This role is probably not for you if:



You need step by step direction every day



You only summarize what you saw without explaining why it matters



You wait around for permission before making simple decisions



You struggle to turn research into clear action



What Success Looks Like



You consistently deliver a strong weekly intel brief



Your ideas help the content team create better hooks, better posts, and better angles



You bring useful observations without being chased down



Your research becomes something the team can actually use, not just read once and ignore



How to Apply



Text me directly on WhatsApp at 
In your message, include all 5 of these:



Your full name

A short note, 3 to 5 sentences, on why this role fits you specifically

One example of a recent Instagram post, Reel, or trend you found interesting and why you think it worked

Your hourly rate expectation

Your availability and time zone



Start your message with:



OLJ Research Applicant



Example:

OLJ Research Applicant | Jane Smith



Applications missing any of the 5 required items will not be reviewed.



Following instructions is part of the role.



About Working With Us



We move fast.

You do not need to be perfect, but you do need to be thoughtful, proactive, and able to work without constant follow up.



If you want to grow with a US based business and build real skill in content research, ideation, and strategy support, this is a good role.



If you want one off gigs or constant hand holding, this is not the right fit.

title: Startup Fleet Operations & Growth Operator | Private Car Rental (Remote)
description:
Employment Type: Part-Time (leading to Full-Time)



About the Business:

We are building a private vehicle rental operation that specializes in placing reliable economy vehicles with gig economy drivers on platforms like Uber, Lyft, and DoorDash.

This business is at the ground floor. We have one vehicle, an LLC, and a clear goal to scale to five vehicles in 90 days. There is no existing system, no active client base, and no lead flow yet. We are building that from scratch, and that is exactly why this role exists.



This is not a maintenance job. This is a build job. If you need everything already organized before you can be useful, this is not the right fit.



What This Role Actually Is:

You are the person who helps us go from one car to a real operating business. That means creating structure where there is none, owning driver communication, keeping payment enforcement tight, building a renter pipeline from zero, and helping us move fast without building a mess.

You will not be handed a playbook. You will help write it.



What You Will Own:

You will build and maintain a master tracker covering driver info, vehicle status, payment due dates, days late, GPS notes, risk level, and backup driver pipeline. You will own all driver communication including payment reminders, enforcement messages, and onboarding coordination. You will monitor GPS check-ins and flag anything that needs attention. You will help build the first simple SOPs for onboarding, late payments, and driver offboarding. You will help generate the first renter leads using
 Marketplace, local driver groups, and WhatsApp outreach. You will create a backup driver waitlist so the car is never sitting idle waiting for the next qualified renter.



What I Need From You:

You think in order. You know what to build first and what to leave alone until later. You can enforce payment timelines firmly and professionally without turning it into a conflict. You document everything. You take ownership of your lane without needing a manager standing over your shoulder. You understand that at this stage, one unpaid driver or one idle week has a real impact on the business.



Experience That Helps:

Direct experience is not required, but strong preference goes to anyone who has worked in private car rentals, Turo support, HyreCar, rideshare fleet coordination, driver operations, payment enforcement, lead generation for local service businesses,
 Marketplace listings, or remote operational coordination. You should be comfortable in Google Sheets. If you have used GPS tracking systems or fleet management tools, tell us exactly which ones and what you did with them.



Hours and Pay:

20 hours per week to start. Must be available during CST business hours for overlap. Pay is $5 to $7.50 per hour depending on experience, execution quality, and fit.



How to Apply:

Use the subject line exactly as written: The Sauce: Fleet Operator

Then send all five of the following. Applications missing any of them will not be reviewed.

One, a short summary of your experience in rentals, driver support, operations, or lead generation. Be specific. Do not write general VA experience.



Two, the exact tools you have personally used for tracking, GPS monitoring, CRM, fleet management, or lead handling. Name them and tell us what you did with them.

Three, your answer to this scenario: A driver is two days late on their weekly payment. They are still responding but keep saying tomorrow. The GPS shows the car is active daily. What do you do from this 
nt until it is resolved? Give me the full timeline, what you say, how you document it, and when the kill switch becomes part of the equation.



Four, your answer to this build question: If you stepped into a one car rental business with no lead system, no landing page, and no active clients yet, what are the first five things you build in week one and why? Keep it simple and realistic for this stage.

Five, a two to three minute Loom video explaining why you are the right fit for this specific stage of the business, not fleet management in general.

title: Affiliate Support and Community Manager (TikTok Shop)
description:
Summary

We run TikTok Shop affiliate programs for ecommerce brands. Thousands of creators post about our clients’ products and earn commission. Our job is to keep those creators active, answered, and motivated.



We are hiring one person to own the day to day of a part of that creator program: the inbox, the contests, and the community. You will be the voice creators hear back from, the person who runs our contests, and the one who notices when a creator asks for something our automated system missed.



This is a long term, daily role. We are building something large and want someone who grows with it.



What you will do every day



Work the creator inbox. We use a platform called Euka that holds every message between our brands and their affiliate creators. An AI answers the routine ones. You read through what it handled, catch the asks it missed (a creator wanting a different sample, a commission question, a bundle request, a complaint), reply to what you can, and route the rest to our affiliate lead with a one line summary. You keep a tracker of every open ask so nothing gets lost.

Run contests and promotions. You will post the brief, remind creators mid run, track entries, confirm winners, and post the results. We will give you templates. You make them happen on time and follow up.



Get creators posting more. Check who received samples but has not posted, nudge them, share what is working, celebrate wins publicly in 
, and tell creators when they are close to unlocking the next commission tier.



Report weekly. A short scorecard: open asks, asks resolved, contest participation, creators who posted, creators who moved up a tier.



Hours



20-30 hours a week, Monday to Friday, with a short weekend check in. Coverage must include US evening hours (roughly 5pm to 9pm US Central), because that is when creators are active. A morning block in your time zone plus an evening block works well. We are not looking for 24/7 availability and we do not measure you on response seconds. We measure you on creators answered, contests delivered, and creators posting.



You are a fit if...



You have worked with creators, affiliates, or influencers before, or you have been one. You understand samples, commissions, and why a creator stops posting.

Your written English is natural and warm. You can write a reply a 22 year old US creator would be happy to receive.

You are organized. You like trackers, follow ups, and closing loops.

You are outgoing in text. You can hype an affiliate win and handle a complaint in the same hour.

You have used 
 as a mod or active member, and you know TikTok well.

You can commit to fixed hours for at least 6 months.

Experience with TikTok Shop Affiliate Center, Euka, or similar creator CRM tools a huge plus!

Experience running giveaways or contests

**About Us**



Solution Group is a US-based industrial wastewater treatment company. We operate treatment systems for large food, beverage, and dairy manufacturers across the United States. We're looking for a long-term marketing specialist to run our lead generation and help our sales team find and win new clients.



This is a long-term, full-time role, not a short project.



**What You'll Do**



1. **HubSpot marketing campaigns.** Plan, build, launch, and report on campaigns in HubSpot Marketing Hub. Manage lists, segmentation, landing pages, forms, and campaign attribution.

3. **Lead gathering in ZoomInfo.** Build target lists of manufacturing sites and decision-makers in ZoomInfo. Enrich contacts and import clean records into HubSpot.

4. *
 nurture sequences.** Write and maintain
 sequences for warm and cold prospects. Track opens, replies, and meetings booked, and report results to leadership monthly.

5. **LinkedIn demand generation.** Use company and executive LinkedIn presence to start conversations, grow followers in target accounts, and surface sales opportunities.

6. **Website SEO.** Optimize our website for search: keyword research, on-page fixes, technical health, and content aimed at industrial buyers.

7. **Lead nurturing strategy.** Define how a lead moves from first contact to sales-ready. Set up lifecycle stages, lead scoring, and handoff rules with our sales team.



**Requirements**



- 3+ years of B2B marketing or lead generation experience

- Hands-on HubSpot experience: campaigns, sequences, workflows, lists, and reports

- Experience with ZoomInfo, Apollo, or a similar B2B contact database

- Experience managing LinkedIn profiles and posting for executives or company pages

- Experience with Buffer or a similar social media scheduling tool

- Working knowledge of SEO tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Semrush, or Ahrefs

s and posts that go to senior US executives.

**Nice to Have**



- HubSpot certifications (Marketing Hub, Inbound, or Sales Hub)

- Experience marketing to manufacturing, industrial, or environmental services companies

- Experience setting up lead scoring and lifecycle stages from scratch



**How to Apply**



Send the following:



1. Your resume

2. Your expected monthly salary in USD

title: Full Stack Development Specialist
description:
𝗔𝗿𝗲 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘆 𝘁𝗼 𝗷𝗼𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗔𝗜 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗼𝗹𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻?

We work with business owners to understand their challenges and build solutions using AI and automation. This includes web apps, dashboards and connections between their existing tools to improve how their businesses operate.



We have a very small team with some very large clients, mostly in the USA and Dubai. The development workload is growing, and I need someone I can trust to help us deliver great results.

I'll design the AI features, and you'll build the apps around them and connect them through APIs, so you don't need experience building AI yourself.



AI has made software easier to build. We need someone who can turn a basic AI-generated result into an application that looks good, responds well and is easy to use.



You must understand how the code works and use your own judgement to plan the right solution. You should be comfortable questioning AI suggestions and checking its work.



At first, I may provide project plans. As you become familiar with our work, you'll take more responsibility for understanding client requirements, planning solutions and building them.



You'll have a technical founder to discuss decisions with, plus guidance on design and user experience.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗢𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆:

We encourage you to use 𝗖𝗹𝗮𝘂𝗱𝗲 𝗖𝗼𝗱𝗲 and will provide access to 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵𝗲𝗿-𝘁𝗶𝗲𝗿 𝘀𝘂𝗯𝘀𝗰𝗿𝗶𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗽𝗹𝗮𝗻𝘀 to support your work. We also want to support learning that helps you develop your skills.



The role starts 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁 𝗯𝘆 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁, with some projects lasting several months. As work increases, our aim is to offer a full-time role as a core team member. This will depend on business needs and terms we agree together.



Great results help us win more work - the better you do, the more opportunities will come your way. By joining early and proving your ability, you'll be well placed to take on greater responsibility as we grow.



𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀:

• 𝗣𝗹𝗮𝗻: Understand client requirements and d
 how the solution should work.

• 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱: Create clear, attractive applications that work on desktop and mobile.

• 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗻𝗲𝗰𝘁: Use APIs and webhooks to connect clients' tools, manage access and handle errors.

• 𝗖𝗵𝗲𝗰𝗸: Review AI-generated code and test that the application works correctly.

• 𝗗𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿: Share progress, raise problems early and keep clear notes so others can maintain your work.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴:

• Experience building working web apps or dashboards.

• A good understanding of frontend and backend development, and how they work together.

• Practical experience connecting software through APIs.

• An understanding of databases for structured information and file storage for images, videos and documents.

• The ability to make technical decisions, solve problems and improve the user experience.

• Good English skills. You can understand written requirements, write clear messages and discuss your work in English.

• Reliability, attention to detail and a strong desire to keep learning.



𝗕𝗼𝗻𝘂𝘀 𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁𝘀:

Experience with interface design, accessibility, AI coding tools or business automation.



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗨𝘀:

We'll agree on each project's requirements, delivery stages, fee and expected availability before work begins. But with the amount of work we are expecting soon, we do hope to provide a position full time if we like working with you.

Send a short covering letter.



𝗜𝗠𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗧: In your covering letter, tell us your favourite designed website (or UI library) and why you like it.

title: Sales Pipeline & Follow-Up Management
description:
About the role



I’m an appointment setter supporting existing students in an Amazon reselling education company. I help identify students who may benefit from additional one-on-one coaching or VA support.



I’m looking for an organized assistant who can manage follow-ups, keep my pipeline accurate, and prepare my highest-priority calls for the next day.



This is primarily a CRM organization and written follow-up role. It is not an Amazon product-sourcing job, a cold-calling role, or a sales-closing position.



What you will do



•Review student records in GoHighLevel and our custom student hub.



•Prepare a prioritized list of 5–10 qualified students for the next day's calls when enough suitable opportunities are available. Flag shortfalls rather than adding unqualified people.



•Include a brief reason for each priority, the previous conversation, and the recommended next step.



•Send approved written follow-ups and keep responses organized.



•Track people who never booked, missed appointments, or attended but did not buy. Record the reason and an appropriate next follow-up date.



•Keep contact notes, pipeline stages, and tasks accurate. Flag students who need customer support rather than a sales conversation.



•Send a short end-of-day update covering tomorrow's calls, important replies, and anything needing my decision.



We already have information about students' curriculum progress, goals, and self-reported financial readiness. You will use the available information and our qualification guidelines, not guess or pressure students.



What we are looking for



You should write clear English messages, follow through on tasks, and be comfortable organizing information in a CRM. You must be able to explain why one student should be contacted before another.



Hands-on GoHighLevel experience is preferred. Experience with another CRM, customer support, appointment-setting support, or sales administration is also relevant. We can train you on our student hub and process.



You need a reliable computer and internet connection, a practical plan for interruptions, and availability for the stated schedule. You must respect student confidentiality, contact preferences, and company access rules.



You do not need Amazon reselling experience, advanced CRM automation skills, or experience closing sales.



How to apply



Use the subject line: Pipeline VA — [Your first name].



Please answer these four prompts in order. Keep your answers concise; approximately 250–350 words total is enough. Include a link to your résumé or OnlineJobs.ph profile.



1. Relevant experience: Describe one example of managing follow-ups or organizing a CRM. What did you personally do? Which tools did you use? Be clear about whether you have used GoHighLevel. If you have no direct experience, explain a comparable tracking task you handled.



2. Availability and terms: Confirm whether the stated pay and hours work for you. Give your available work blocks in Philippine time, earliest start date, and your plan for internet or power interruptions.



3. Prioritization: Student A has completed most of the curriculum, has documented financial readiness, and asked two days ago about one-on-one support. Student B has similar readiness but explicitly asked us to stop contacting them. Student C is early in the course and needs help accessing lessons. Who should go on tomorrow's sales calling list, and what would you do with the others? Explain in 3–5 sentences.



4. Send a short video on why you would be a good fit for this position.



Shortlisted applicants will receive a paid, approximately 45-minute exercise using fictional student records. Finalists will have a short call to discuss their work and confirm the schedule. No access to live student data is needed during screening.



Applications that omit the requested answers or contain only a generic cover letter will not move forward.

title: Acquisitions Specialist – Texas Foreclosure Homeowner Outreach (2 Openings, Full-Time)
description:
Company: Nationwide Equity (Texas, USA)

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-6:00 PM US Central Time, with a 1-hour break

Type: Full-time, 40 hrs/week, 2 openings, fixed salary + bonus

Start: Within 1-2 weeks of hire



ABOUT US

Nationwide Equity is a Texas real estate company. We work with homeowners and families dealing with mortgage foreclosure and tax foreclosure, and we've closed more than 65 foreclosure purchases over the past 4 years.



Selling isn't the only option we offer. Sometimes the right answer is helping the owner keep the house, through reinstatement, lender negotiation, a postponement or help from our attorney. Many of our properties belong to owners who passed away, so a lot of our conversations are with heirs and family members going through a hard time.



THIS IS NOT A HARD-SELL JOB

You won't be pitching cash offers or pushing anyone to sign. Your job is to start real conversations, understand what's going on in someone's life, and build enough trust that they want to keep talking to us. When a lead is ready to talk numbers, you hand them to our acquisitions manager.



Before each call, our system gives you a research summary on the property and the people connected to it: ownership, auction date, liens, heirs and a suggested approach angle. You use it to guide the conversation so it sounds informed and personal, not scripted.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call and text owners, relatives, heirs and neighbors connected to foreclosure and tax-auction properties in Texas

- Read the research summary before each call and use the approach angle to open the conversation

- Listen and find out the real situation: who lives there, who makes decisions, what's behind the foreclosure, what the family wants

- Identify the pain points (deadlines, money pressure, family disagreements, a house nobody can manage) and write them up clearly

- Talk with neighbors respectfully to help locate owners or family members

- Follow up and keep relationships warm over days and weeks, not just one call

- Log every conversation, note and next step in GoHighLevel (GHL) the same day

- Hand warm leads to the acquisitions manager with a clear summary of the situation



WHAT WE NEED

- At least 1 year of phone work for a US company, ideally real estate (cold calling, lead management or appointment setting for investors or wholesalers)

- Clear, natural, warm spoken English. People should feel comfortable talking to you, even on a hard day

- Patience and real empathy. You'll talk with people who are grieving, embarrassed or scared of losing their home

- Strong note-taking. Your summaries are what our team acts on

- Comfortable using a CRM (GoHighLevel preferred) and following a research brief

- A quiet workspace, a noise-canceling USB headset, fast internet (25 Mbps+) and a backup power or internet plan

- Comfortable working US Central Time hours



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with pre-foreclosure, tax-delinquent, probate or inherited-property leads

- Some understanding of how US foreclosure, tax sales or probate work

- Customer service, healthcare or collections background (people who are good with sensitive calls)



PAY

Fixed monthly salary, paid on time every pay period, plus a performance bonus. Long-term role with room to grow.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed.

1. Start your application with the words: "Texas Outreach"

2. Send a short voice recording (1-2 minutes). The scenario: you're calling the daughter of a homeowner who passed away. The house goes to a tax auction in 30 days, and she doesn't know about it yet. Introduce yourself and start the conversation. We're listening for warmth and how you handle it, not a sales pitch.

3. In 3-5 sentences, tell us about a phone conversation where someone was upset or didn't trust you, and how you handled it.

4. List the CRMs and calling tools you've used, and for how long.

5. Tell us your earliest start date.
